question: As of July 2023, the Vivek Express Train has longest route in India running between ________ and Kanyakumari.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dibrugarh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Vivek Express is the longest train route in India, covering a distance of 4,273 kilometers.
 
• It travels from Dibrugarh in Assam to Kanyakumari in Tamil Nadu, connecting the northeastern part of India to the southernmost tip.
 
• The train journey takes approximately 82 hours and 30 minutes, making it the longest train journey in terms of time as well.
 
• Vivek Express was introduced in 2011 to commemorate the 150th birth anniversary of Swami Vivekananda, hence the name Vivek Express.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dibrugarh**

 
 
• Dibrugarh is a city in the northeastern state of Assam, India, and is known as the "Tea City of India" due to its numerous tea estates.
 
• It is an important commercial center of Assam and serves as a major gateway to the eastern part of the state.
 
• Dibrugarh is well connected by rail, road, and air, making it accessible for travelers and trade.
 
• The city also has a rich cultural heritage, with numerous festivals and traditions celebrated throughout the year.
 
 
 
• **Kanyakumari**
 
 
• Kanyakumari is a coastal town in the southernmost part of India, located in the state of Tamil Nadu.
 
• It is renowned for its unique geographical location where the Indian Ocean, Arabian Sea, and Bay of Bengal meet.
 
• Kanyakumari is also famous for its beautiful sunrise and sunset views, attracting tourists from all over the world.
 
• The town has several historical and cultural landmarks, including the Vivekananda Rock Memorial and the Thiruvalluvar Statue.
 
 
 
• **Swami Vivekananda**
 
 
• Swami Vivekananda was a Hindu monk and a key figure in the introduction of Indian philosophies of Vedanta and Yoga to the Western world.
 
• He was born on January 12, 1863, and his teachings and philosophy have inspired millions of people worldwide.
 
• Swami Vivekananda is best known for his speech at the Parliament of the World's Religions in Chicago in 1893, where he began his address with "Sisters and brothers of America."
 
• His birth anniversary is celebrated as National Youth Day in India to honor his contributions and inspire the youth of the country.
